project.name: Guided example D2-LR
project.description: Guided example (Doc 12 X9, D-92, D-121): design D2-LR of Doc 13 §4, D2 with one BLOCK LR3 40-4 coupling reactor per inverter (INV1 0.30 mH, INV2 0.42 mH; X11, D-119), small-signal stable. Same study limits, scenarios D2S and D2H and Transient presets as the guided example D2, so the D2 validation cases can be compared by value on a stable design. Tailored to the base catalogue (D-116).
